process.title: A structured mission
process.intro: Whether the topic is AI automation or a 3D / XR application, I start by analyzing the work, defining a clear scope with you, then moving forward with progressive, verifiable builds.

discovery.title: Understand the context and choose the angle of attack
discovery.body: Goals, users, repeated tasks, technical constraints, available data or assets, timeline: we establish what matters before producing.

points.plan: By the end of this step: a clear priority and a first-version scope.

build.title: Develop a first usable version
build.body: Automation, integration, interface, 3D / XR scene or targeted recovery: the format depends on the need, not on a fixed recipe.

stackItems.delivery: Deliver regularly so the work can be tested, adjusted and decided on before the end.

launch.title: Stabilize and prepare what comes after
launch.body: Cleanup, documentation, deployment, handover or next iterations: the project should remain usable after my intervention.

measure.body: Make sure the project can be resumed, maintained or extended later without starting over.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains, in plain terms, what data the edge-solutions.be website may process and why.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
body: Edge Solutions is the public website of Gil Guminski, a freelance developer based in Belgium.
The website does not provide user accounts, login, comments, checkout, or user-generated content.

whatDataWeCollect.title: What data we collect
body: If you only browse the website, we mainly collect technical and statistical information related to the visit.
If you contact us by form or email, we may process the information you voluntarily provide: name, email address, project type and message content.
To prevent abuse, contact form submissions are rate-limited by IP address through our host's firewall, Vercel.

cookiesAndGoogleTags.title: Cookies and Google tags
body: Google tags and Google Analytics, when an ID is configured, as well as Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights are optional measurement tools. They load only after your explicit consent.
Rejecting keeps them disabled. Your browser stores your choice, and the Analytics settings link in the footer lets you change it or withdraw consent.
Google may process technical data such as cookies, IP address, browser and device information, pages visited, referrer and approximate location.

The current setup sends navigation and conversion events, such as contact clicks, service pages viewed, selected language, scroll depth and the general result of a form submission. It does not intentionally send Google the visitor’s name, email address or message content.

Vercel remains necessary to host and serve the website regardless of your choice. Its optional Web Analytics and Speed Insights tools provide aggregated traffic and performance statistics only after consent.

whyWeUseData.title: Why we use data
body: We use data to respond to requests, understand which pages are useful, improve website performance and keep the website working correctly.

dataSharing.title: Data sharing
body: Edge Solutions does not sell personal data.

Some data may be processed by providers: Vercel for essential hosting and, after your consent, Google for tags and analytics and Vercel for optional traffic and performance measurement; Resend or the email provider handles contact message delivery.

dataRetention.title: Data retention
body: Contact messages are kept only as long as needed to respond to the request, handle normal follow-up and meet applicable administrative or legal obligations.
Analytics and performance data are retained according to the settings and retention periods of the tools used. Aggregated reports may be kept for longer.

yourGdprRights.title: Your GDPR rights
body: You can ask to access, correct, erase, restrict or receive a copy of your personal data. You can also object to certain processing or withdraw consent where the processing is based on consent.
You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
